description: Use when you need to resolve an ENS name to an address, reverse-resolve an address to its ENS name, or read an ENS avatar and profile records. Do not use for registering or renewing names, or non-ENS naming such as Solana SNS. Returns JSON with an ENS lookup on Ethereum in one call: the address of a name, the verified primary name of an address (reverse), the avatar and text records such as url, twitter and github for 0.003 USDC per call. Typical response time 2000 ms (p95). Category: Data.

address.description: Ethereum address to reverse-resolve, e.g. 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045 (send name or address, not both)

name.description: ENS name to resolve, e.g. vitalik.eth (send name or address, not both)

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

texts.description: Text record keys to read (avatar, url, description, com.twitter, com.github and email when omitted), e.g. ["url", "com.github"]

name: blackwood_ens_lookup

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: ENS name lookup
